an4.171:1.1: kāye vā bhikkhave sati kāyasañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ
an4.171:1.2: vācāya vā bhikkhave sati vacīsañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ
an4.171:1.3: mane vā bhikkhave sati manosañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ avijjāpaccayā vā
an4.171:2.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ bhikkhave kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ
an4.171:2.2: pare vāssa taṃ bhikkhave kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharonti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ sampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ asampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ sāmaṃ vā taṃ bhikkhave vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ pare vāssa taṃ bhikkhave vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharonti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ sampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ asampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ sāmaṃ vā taṃ bhikkhave manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ pare vāssa bhikkhave manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ
an4.171:2.3: sampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ
an4.171:5.2: avijjāyatveva asesavirāganirodhā so kāyo na hoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ sā vācā na hoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ so mano na hoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ
an4.171:5.3: khettantaṃ na hoti … vatthuntaṃ na hoti … āyatanantaṃ na hoti … adhikaraṇantaṃ na hoti yaṃpaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
an4.171:6.3: atthi bhikkhave attabhāvapaṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā kamati no parasañcetanā
an4.171:6.4: atthi bhikkhave attabhāvapaṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe parasañcetanā kamati no attasañcetanā
an4.171:6.5: atthi bhikkhave attabhāvapaṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā ca kamati parasañcetanā ca
an4.171:6.6: atthi bhikkhave attabhāvapaṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe neva attasañcetanā kamati no parasañcetanā
an4.171:7.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an4.171:7.2: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi
an4.171:7.3: tatra bhante yvāyaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā kamati no parasañcetanā attasañcetanāhetu tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā kāyā cuti hoti
an4.171:7.4: tatra bhante yvāyaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe parasañcetanā kamati no attasañcetanā parasañcetanāhetu tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā kāyā cuti hoti
an4.171:7.5: tatra bhante yvāyaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā ca kamati parasañcetanā ca attasañcetanācaparasañcetanācahetu tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā kāyā cuti hoti
an4.171:7.6: tatra bhante yvāyaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe neva attasañcetanā kamati no parasañcetanā katame tena devā daṭṭhabbāti.
an4.171:8.1: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā tamhā kāyā cutā āgāmino honti āgantāro itthattaṃ
an4.171:8.2: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā tamhā kāyā cutā anāgāmino honti anāgantāro itthattanti.
an4.171:8.3: idha sāriputta ekaccassa puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saññojanāni appahīnāni honti so diṭṭheva dhamme nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.171:8.4: so tadassādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati
an4.171:8.5: tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno nevasaññānāsaññāyatanupagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati
an4.171:8.6: so tato cuto āgāmī hoti āgantā itthattaṃ
